meta.parties: Saurmma Et Al. v. Mohamadu Lebbe

rules.statement: A person cannot enrich himself at the expense of another, and a party who was himself a party to an illegal consideration is precluded from obtaining assistance of the law to recover it.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is a maxim of law, established, not for the benefit of plaintiffs or defendants, but is founded on the principles of public policy, which will not assist a plaintiff who has paid over money or handed over property in pursuance of an illegal or immoral contract, to recover it back"
